messages.text:
Here are the three parts of your request.

**Colander receipt:** The stainless colander (h466-o1-u1) was refunded, 138.00 BRL. The receipt number is R-H466-0001. The refund is recorded against the order's original payment. It can't be refunded again (refund-policy/v2/remaining). The receipt records the refund in the shop's test ledger. It isn't a bank transfer, and the shop gives no date for the money to appear (refund-policy/v2/payout).

**Silicone splatter screen:** The shop's records don't show this item as received back yet, so I can't request a refund for it now. The shop refunds only units it has received back, according to its own return records (refund-policy/v2/return). Once it arrives, a request can be made. Your refund deadline is 2026-11-30 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). If you're certain it was sent and the records are wrong, tell me and a staff member can check.

**Shipping charges:** Shipping is never refunded automatically (refund-policy/v2/shipping). Would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge?
